beat1_summary: Your steadiest month of the year. Nothing spiked, but almost everything moved the right way, and the two numbers we flagged in July both recovered.
work_chips: Themes: shoe-fitting expertise, run club, community causes
beat2_takeaway: We published 13 pieces in August, seven Reels and six carousels, weighted toward the fitting expertise that sets you apart from buying shoes online.
beat3_takeaway: Eight of twelve metrics finished on track and none landed in outlier-low territory. Retention cleared the Spark floor and saves came back from a low of two.
beat4_takeaway: The shoe-fitting explainer was the month's standout, saved eleven times more than an average post. People want the expertise, not the product shot.
beat5_takeaway: September is about comments. Reach and conversion are steady, so the gap now is getting people talking rather than just watching.

goal_narratives: Awareness scored 50%, up from July. Views rose to 19,780 and held inside your Spark range, with new followers the one metric still under the 40 floor.
Engagement scored 48%, up from July. Retention climbed from 33% to 41% and cleared the Spark floor, and saves recovered from 2 to 11.
Conversion scored 62%, your strongest band and up from July. Bio link taps, click-through rate and profile conversion all finished inside the Spark range.
